raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The DE-412 change added a filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 hours` to silver_transactions. From batch 3 onward, roughly a quarter of each batch arrives about 2–3 days late, as the samples show (e.g. txn_ts 2026-01-13 ingested 2026-01-16), so the filter silently drops these valid POSTED transactions. txn_ids are unique, so the late rows are not duplicates or replays, and removing the latency filter restores complete silver and gold data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.62, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
